description: Full SwinL BiRefNet_HR at a fixed 800-pixel input for native CPU and NVIDIA CUDA execution.

models.title: BiRefNet HR800 background removal
models.source_note: The full trained SwinL checkpoint is exported with deformable convolution decomposed into standard ONNX GridSample operations. This pinned FP32 export has x [1,3,800,800] and raw mask logits [1,1,800,800]. RGB images use cubic resize and ImageNet normalization. A single sigmoid and linear mask resize produce straight alpha at the original image size. The upstream checkpoint was trained at 2048 pixels; this 800-pixel profile does not claim upstream 2048-pixel benchmark scores.
